scenarios.title: Place a GTC limit buy order on a binary prediction market
scenarios.event: User asks to buy 10 shares at $0.50 on a specific token ID
scenarios.expectedAction: Authenticate via L1→L2, validate tick size, place GTC order, return orderID and status

scenarios.title: Place a FOK market buy order spending $100
scenarios.event: User asks to market buy $100 worth of YES tokens with FOK
scenarios.expectedAction: Create market order with amount=100, submit as FOK, report fill or cancellation

scenarios.title: Batch place 5 orders across bid/ask spread
scenarios.event: User asks to place 5 orders at different price levels on the same token
scenarios.expectedAction: Create 5 signed orders, submit via postOrders batch API, report individual results

scenarios.title: Cancel all orders for a specific market
scenarios.event: User asks to cancel all orders on a specific condition ID
scenarios.expectedAction: Call cancelMarketOrders with the condition ID, confirm cancellation

scenarios.title: Order rejected due to tick size mismatch
scenarios.event: User tries to place order at price 0.555 but market tick size is 0.01
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect INVALID_ORDER_MIN_TICK_SIZE error, suggest rounding to 0.56 or 0.55

scenarios.title: Heartbeat timeout would cancel all orders
scenarios.event: Heartbeat thread fails to send within 10 seconds
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect heartbeat failure, warn user that open orders may be cancelled, attempt recovery

scenarios.title: Order exceeds safety limit of $1000
scenarios.event: User asks to place a $1500 order
scenarios.expectedAction: Reject order before submission, report safety limit violation, suggest smaller size

scenarios.title: Place order on negative risk multi-outcome market
scenarios.event: User asks to buy YES on a neg-risk market (e.g., election with 3+ outcomes)
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect negRisk=true, use Neg Risk CTF Exchange, pass negRisk:true in options

criteria: L1 EIP-712 credential derivation and L2 HMAC authentication succeed: Does the skill correctly derive API credentials and authenticate for trading?
Order price conforms to market tick size: Does the skill validate and adjust price to the market's minimum tick size?
All order types (GTC, GTD, FOK, FAK) placed correctly: Does the skill handle different order type semantics (amount vs size)?
Batch orders up to 15 submitted in single request: Does the skill create and submit batch orders efficiently?
Safety limits enforced before order submission: Does the skill validate against MAX_ORDER_SIZE_USD and other limits?
Heartbeat maintained to prevent order cancellation: Does the skill manage the 10-second heartbeat requirement?
Order lifecycle tracked from MATCHED to CONFIRMED/FAILED: Does the skill monitor and report final order status?
Negative risk markets handled with correct exchange contract: Does the skill detect and use the appropriate exchange?
